spiritgiven.comments: MANY calm and productive communications that quickly brought temperatures down in a hard fought game. Great game!

Generally, a good game with good communication. We do want to bring up that #22 was a little verbally aggressive with one of our players. This stemmed from a contact call very early in the game where she yelled at one of our player who stayed calm in response but was crying on the sidelines. However, we want to be clear that one person’s action does not reflect upon the whole,team. It was a pleasure to play with your team and good luck in the tournament.

This game was a delight. Spirited and extremely fun. Our 4 ranking is specifically for attitude. They complemented good plays on and off the field and made the game the most spirited one we've played at this tournament.

This was the closest game we've played this week. I've never seen players stay so calm in talking out close calls ESPECIALLY at the end of the game. Completely across the board the players were supportive and communicative. This game was an absolute joy to play and it's what I wish all ultimate games could be. High competition with the highest spirit.
This was a very fun game to play. When we had small issues they were addressed quickly and calmly and we really appreciated it.

spiritgiven.comments: We appreciate their body control and patience in this game. Discussions were approached in a calm and considerate way. Good game, Notquick- we hope to play y'all again next year!

spiritreceived.comments:
Thank you for a well spirited game. 
Kar and Sarah are great.
Both sides had some calls made both ways, but we all talked through our calls and both sides were cordial and controlled through the call process.

Very fun game!  We really enjoyed the people on Archive - probably the most fun sideline we’ve had all tournament.  Not a ton of calls, very fair minded conversations when there were calls.  Almost no body contact/fouls from their team, but also almost no hand signals.
